definition: [ לוּלַי ] noun feminine loop (probably from לולו ; compare [ דוּדַי ] p. 188 above; Zehnpf BAS i. 635 , compare Assyrian lu-lu, 'Schleife' ); — only plural absolute לָֻלָאֹת Exod 26:5 (3 t. in verse) + 8 t., construct לֻלְאֹת Exod 26:4 ; Exod 36:11 — loops on edges of curtains of tabernacle, matching the hooks (קְרָסִיםׅ , for joining the ourtains: Exod 26:4 ; Exod 26:5 (3 t. in verse); Exod 26:10 (twice in verse); Exod 26:11 ; Exod 36:11 ; Exod 36:12 (3 t. in verse); Exod 36:17 (twice in verse) (all P ). לוּלֵי see לוּלֵא below לוּ .

לוּלֵי see לוּלֵא below לוּ.
